cittekagga.p: [Citta+ekagga] (na) CL=10 Being the mind has only one sense object; Having a single sense of the mind; Tranquility of mind.
a: စိတ္တေကဂ္ဂ(န)

(~an ti ārammaṇaṃ cintetī ti ~aṃ, vijānātī ti attho … vipākaṃ kammakilesehi citan ti ~aṃ. api ca sabbaṃ pi yathānurūpato cittatāya ~aṃ, cittakaraṇatāya ~an ti evaṃ p’ ettha attho veditabbo, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee kammakilesehi ~an ti ~aṃ) quoted Sadd 537, 18 foll. ; As 112, 20 (cakkhunā hi diṭṭhaṃ rūpārammaṇaṃ ~en’ eva vijānāti); Mhv 38:89 (na jānāsi ~aṃ etassa); Sadd 537, 17 (cinta cintāyaṃ: cinteti cintayati ~aṃ cintā cintanā); — ifc see aññā-, adhimutta- ( sv adhimuccati ), anaggahīta- ( sv aggahī̆ta 1 ), anāsatta- ( sv āsatta ), aneka- ( sv eka ), apeta- ( sv apeti ), alīna- ( sv līna ), avaharaṇa-, avisāhaṭa- ( sv visāhaṭa ), upārambha-, ubbhanta-, ekagga- ( sv eka ), khitta- ( sv khipati 1 ), gathita- ( sv ganthati ), gadhita-, gamika-, gedhita-, cala-, theyya-, nikaṭṭha- ( sv nikaṭṭha 2 ), nikkaṭṭha- ( sv nikkaḍḍhati ), paṭipesita-, paṭibaddha- ( sv paṭibandhati ), pariyādinna- ( sv pariyādiyati ), pariyuṭṭhita- ( sv pariyuṭṭhati ), lahu-, vikkhitta- ( sv vikkhipati ), vipphandamāna- ( sv vipphandati ), vibbhanta- ( sv vibbhamati ), vyāpanna- ( sv vyāpajjati ), samoha- ( sv moha ); — 2. a single thought; a thought-moment; a moment of consciousness ; Abh 838 (viññāṇe … ~aṃ); Vin I 93, 21 (yaṃ bhikkhave mātu kucchismiṃ paṭhamaṃ ~aṃ uppannaṃ paṭhamaṃ viññāṇaṃ pātubhūtaṃ tadupādāya sā v’ assa jāti; Sp 437, 16 : paṭhamaṃ ~an ti paṭhamaṃ paṭisandhi-cittaṃ); Paṭis I 57, 30 (rūpārammaṇatā ~aṃ uppajjitvā bhijjati); Dhs 1 (yasmiṃ samaye kāmāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ ~aṃ uppannaṃ hoti somanassasahagataṃ ñāṇa-sampayuttaṃ rūpārammanaṃ …); Vibh 87, 23 (cakkhuṃ ca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati ~aṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ … viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjā cakkhu-viññāṇadhātu, ayaṃ vuccati cakkhuviññāṇadhātu); Kv 41, 29 foll. (yasmā vā ~an ti sabbacittasādhāraṇo esa saddo tasmā yad ettha lokiyakusalākusalamahākiriyacittaṃ taṃ javanavīthivasena attano santānaṃ cinotī ti ~aṃ); Vibh-a 355, 15* (aññam uppajjati ~aṃ aññaṃ ~aṃ nirujjhati avīcim anusambandho nadīsoto va vattati); — ifc see kiriyā-, carima-, carimaka-, cuti-, paṭisandhi-, vīthi-; — 3. ( n., nom. pl. ~ā, ~āni, or mfn. ? see Sadd 227, 1 foll. and 229, 2 foll. ) mental state, type of consciousness; ; Dhs p. 5, 11 (~ā dhammā no ~ā dhammā; As 49, 25 : cintanaṭṭhena ~ā vicittaṭṭhena vā ~ā, Be, Se so; Vibh 79, 5 (manāyatanaṃ ~aṃ, ekāyatanā no ~ā); 118, 35 (tīṇi saccā no ~ā, dukkhasaccaṃ siyā ~aṃ siyā no ~aṃ); 403, 40 (katamāni satta ~āni, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ sotaviññānaṃ … manodhātu manoviññāṇadhātu); 427, 36 (cha ~ā abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā na pahātabbā … manoviññāṇa-dhātu abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā siyā pahātabbā …); 430, 3 (satta ~ā na diṭṭhā na sutā na mutā viññātā); — cittaṃ in Ee at S I 126, 10* is wr for vittaṃ ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — cittaṃ in Ee, Se at Ja IV 177, 21* and in Ee at Ja V 116, 25* is wr for vittaṃ ( Be, Ce so ); — cittaṃ in Ee at As 154, 19 (vedayitaṭṭhena eko va dhammo ~aṃ) is prob. wr; read vedayitaṭṭhena eko va dhammo vedanā … cittavicittaṭṭhena eko va dhammo ~aṃ with Be, Ce, Se ; — ° âdhipati , m. , thought or consciousness as the dominant influence ; Kv 508, 33 (nanu ~i sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipatī ti); As 213, 15 (dvinnaṃ pana cittānaṃ ekato abhāvena sampayuttacittassa ~i nāma natthi); — ° ânugatika , mfn. , adapted to the thought; imitating thought ; Vism 405, 2 (kāyaṃ gahetva citte āropeti ~aṃ karoti sīghagamanaṃ); Ud-a 93, 26 (~aṃ kāyaṃ adhiṭṭhahantassa); — ° ânuparivattin , mfn. , moving after or along with thought; changing in conformity to thought ; Dhs 671 (kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ~i); 1522 (vedanā-kkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho kāya-viññatti vacīviññatti ime dhammā ~ino); Kv 437, 2 (sīlaṃ na ~ī ti); As 337, 19 (~-tāya); — ° ânupassanā , f. , ~a, n. , contemplation of the thinking or thoughts ; Paṭis I 190, 12 (citte ~ā satipaṭṭhānabhāvanā ti); 191, 29 (cattāri suttantikavatthūni citte ~āya); Peṭ 95, 3 (citte ~ā nirodhaṃ bhajati); Ps I 279, 29 (soḷasavidhena ~aṃ kathetum); Nidd-a I 54, 7 (samatikkamati ~ena); — ° ânupassi(n) , mfn. , considering, contemplating the thinking or thoughts ; D II 299, 7 foll. = M I 59, 29 foll. ; Peṭ 159, 7 (~issa paṭighātena khiyanā idaṃ thīna-middhaṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee wr cittānupassassa); Ps I 280, 22 (sarāgādiparigaṇhanena yasmiṃ yasmiṃ khaṇe yaṃ yaṃ cittaṃ pavattati taṃ taṃ sallakkhento attano vā citte parassa vā citte kālena vā attano kālena vā parassa citte ~ī viharati); — ° ânumajjaka , mfn. , applying (continuous) pressure of thought or on the thoughts ; As 181, 29 (tassa pādaparimajjakapuriso viya imassāpi ārammaṇe ~o vicāro, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce cittānumajjanako); — ° ânurakkhi(n) , mfn. , who guard the thoughts ; Th 1140 (pahomi maggaṃ paṭipajjituṃ sivaṃ ~īhi sadā nivesitaṃ); — °’- antara , mfn. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) having the interval of a thought-moment ;? A V 300, 9 (itthiyā vā bhikkhave purisassa vā nāyaṃ kāyo ādāyagamanīyo, ~o ayaṃ bhikkhave macco; Mp V 77, 25 foll. : ~o ti cittakāraṇo, atha vā citten’ eva antariko, ekass’ eva hi cuticittassa anantarā dutiye paṭisandhicitte devo nāma hoti …); — 2. ( n. ) the difference between thought-moments ;? the variety of thought-moments ;? Ps II 256, 13 (sukhumaṃ pana ~aṃ khandhantaraṃ dhātantaraṃ āyatanantaraṃ … ābhidhammikadhamma-kathikass’ eva pākaṭaṃ; Ps-ṭ [ Be ] II 191, 6 : cakkhusannissitam eva pana viññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ tadanantaraṃ sampaṭicchanaṃ tadanantaraṃ santīraṇan ti ādinā saṇhaṃ sukhumaṃ ati-ittarakhaṇavantaṃ ~aṃ cittanānattaṃ); — °’- anvaya , mfn. , linked to, dependent on the thoughts ; M I 238, 8 (~o kāyo hoti, cittassa vasena vattati); — ° âlaṅkāra , mfn. , which adorns or improves (makes fit?) the thoughts ; A IV 62, 5 (~aṃ cittaparikkhāraṃ dānaṃ deti, Se so; Ce ~aṃ citta-parikkhāran ti dānaṃ; Be ~-cittaparikkhāraṃ dānaṃ; Ee ~aṃ cittaparikkhāratthaṃ dānaṃ, prob. wr ; Mp IV 33, 17 foll. : samathavipassanācittassa alaṅkārabhūtaṃ c’ eva parivārabhūtaṃ ca); — ° âlaṅkāracittaparikkhāra , m. , adornment or improvement (making fit?) and equipping of thinking ; D III 258, 15 (~’-atthaṃ dānaṃ deti; Sv 1044, 27 foll. : samathavipassanācittassa alaṅkāratthaṃ c’ eva parivāratthaṃ ca deti, dānaṃ hi cittaṃ muduṃ karoti) = A IV 237, 1 ; — °’- ānantariya , °’-ānantarika, n. , the immediate succession of thought-moments or consciousnesses ; Paṭis I 17, 24 (cittaṭṭho abhiññeyyo, ~’-aṭṭho abhiññeyyo, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se cittānantarikaṭṭho; Paṭis-a 99, 3 : cittassa ānantariyaṃ ~aṃ); II 121, 6 (~’-aṭṭhaṃ bujjhantī ti bojjhaṅgā, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se cittānantarikaṭṭhaṃ); — °’- ābhoga , m. [citta + ābhoga 2 ( or ābhoga 1 ?)], concentration of thought; consciousness ; Abh 159 (~o manakkāro); — °’- āvāraṃ in Ce, Ee and cittavāraṃ in Se at Ps IV 229, 22 are wrr for cittācāraṃ ( Be so ); — °’- utrāsana , n. , mental fear or dread ; Nidd-a I 426, 29 (bhayan ti ~aṃ); — °’- uppīḷaka , °’- uppīḷanaka , mfn. , pressing the thoughts ; As 181, 28 (hatthapāduppīḷanakapurisa-catukkaṃ viya … ārammaṇe °’-uppīḷako nekkhamma-vitakko, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se °’-uppīḷanako); 182, 1 (°’-uppīlakavitakkāsahanena, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °’-uppīḷanaka-); — °’- ekagga , m. , concentration of thought ; Vin II 235, 23* (asuddhasīlo duppañño ~aṃ na vindati); Sv 562, 11 (na mayhaṃ ~-karaṇe bhāro atthī ti, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se °’-ekaggatākaraṇe) = Ps III 258, 21 ( Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °’-ekaggatākaraṇe); Ps I 124, 29 (imāni … cattāri jhānāni kesañci ~’-atthāni honti, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be °’-ekaggatatthāni; = Sp 156, 18 : eds °’-ekaggat-atthāni); 186, 8 (jhānaṃ pan’ assa ~-mattaṃ karoti); Thī-a 75, 15 (cittassa upasamaṃ ~aṃ na ajjhagan ti); — °- kali , m. , a mind that is bad-luck, a mind of ill-omen ; Th 214 (tāhaṃ ~iṃ brūmi; or read citta kaliṃ; Th-a II 79, 16 foll. : taṃ tasmā pamattabhāvato ambho ~iṃ cittakāḷakaṇṇiṃ ahaṃ kathayāmi, Ce so; Be, Se omit ambho; Ee ambho citta kalicitta kāḷakaṇṇiṃ ahaṃ kathayāmi); 356 (na ca ~i punappunaṃ pasahaṃ pāparato carissasi); — °- kālusiya , °-kālussiya, n. , dirtiness, soiling of the thoughts ; Ud-a 164, 5 (~-karaṇato cittappakopā rāgādayo, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se cittakālussiya-); — °- keḷi , f. cittekaggatā.p: [Citta+ekaggatā] (thī) CL=10 Being the mind has only one sense object; Having a single sense of the mind; Tranquility of mind; Ekaggatā Cetasika, Samādhi.
